decks.summary: Introductory Hemlock Vale Alessandra who parleys every turn with Beguile, Grift, Snitch and Vamp, takes clues through Fake Credentials and Lola Santiago, and uses Fine Clothes for easier parleys.
Enemy-handling Alessandra who deals with foes through parley: British Bull Dog, Stir the Pot, String of Curses and Vamp, with Eyes of Valusia charging up for burst damage; works in true solo.
Deck-cycling Alessandra who draws tricks and favors with Friends in Low Places and Black Market, sets weaknesses aside, and vacuums clues with Snitch and Intel Report while Beguile holds enemies.
Low-XP Alessandra who funds herself with Bank Job, Grift and Bianca, manipulates enemies with Beguile and Power Word, and takes clues with Lockpicks and Fake Credentials.
Parley-queen Alessandra who talks her way through everything with Beguile, Drain Essence, Persuasion, Power Word and Vamp, doubled by Eldritch Tongue and eased by Fine Clothes.
Two-player flex Alessandra from 0 to 34 XP: parley events for her bonus action, Stall for Time and Beguile to stay safe, British Bull Dog and Stir the Pot for damage, and Lola Santiago for clues.
The earlier Goon Alessandra: British Bull Dog, Stir the Pot and String of Curses handle enemies through parley, with Backpack and Sleight of Hand for tempo and Bewitching as the top upgrade.
True solo curse-whisperer Alessandra who controls enemies with Beguile and loads doom on them with String of Curses and Whispers of Doom, replayed by Eldritch Tongue, while Lockpicks take clues.
Heist-leader Alessandra who shrinks her deck to about 15 cards by replaying parley events through Eldritch Tongue, with Walter Fitzpatrick, Snitch and Vamp from The Drowned City.
Two-box Hemlock Vale Alessandra built to work without Fine Clothes: Beguile, Grift and Stir the Pot for enemies, Flashlights and Fake Credentials for clues, and Leo De Luca for tempo.
